title: Mum Leaves Her 5-Year-Old Daughter In A Motel For Hours
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 2nd, 2023. A woman called 911 in regards to her 5-year-old granddaughter who was left with a random maintenance man at a motel by her mother. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
